title: TC's Keys
description: This is a resource pack that changes the textures of keys in the BudgieNet minecraft server.
body:
![TC's Keys: Now on Modrinth!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3229b5d528d6f66265b4895f965a79dba7aac204.png)

### ![[Spawner Crate] Key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16f986498a9e83be4dde8dbb78931bd8be28f9f0.gif) TC's Keys ![[Spawner Crate] Key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16f986498a9e83be4dde8dbb78931bd8be28f9f0.gif)

This is TC's Keys, a resource pack that changes the key textures from the BudgieNet minecraft server. 

There are 2 distinct versions of this resource pack;
**Classic Edition (Version A)**, this version uses the old textures for the keys as well as new key textures in the style of the old ones.
**Modern Edition (Version B)**, this version gives new textures to all the keys that have a bit more detail and a few re-designs for theming purposes.

### Consider joining the BudgieNet Discord Server
That's right! I didn't link **my** discord server, I linked the BudgieNet server!

# **How to install**
1. Download it and haphazardly throw it into the resource packs folder.
2. That's it
3. it's not hard, just press that one button in the resource pack screen
4. ^

I'll be waiting for my paycheck in the mail _(joke)_
